snippets.title: Ask for a minimal reproduction
snippets.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Could you share the steps to reproduce {{issue}}, the result you expected, and the result you saw? Please remove passwords, tokens and private customer details from any examples.

Thanks,
{{your_name}}

snippets.title: Confirm a resolution
snippets.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We changed {{change}} to address {{issue}}. You can check it by {{verification_step}}. Please let us know if the issue remains.

Thanks,
{{your_name}}
